items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: My mother had a second floor... he'd have these different piano players come in... like Paul Lamoar, from Baltimore, Washington -- like come down on the weekend and visit us.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

he would have like -- outstanding piano players would come down from Philly, (inaudible). My mother had a second floor which was really a sun parlor. And in that room my father had bought him two baby grand pianos and it was locked together. And he'd have these different piano players come in (inaudible), like Paul Lamoar, from Baltimore, Washington -- like come down on the weekend and visit us.
Do you remember -- I know you were small boy then -- but do you remember any names?
